messages:
maria: Morning triage — quick snapshot: 68 open tickets (P1 x1, P2 x4). Noticed embeddings returning intermittent 504/502 starting ~04:12 UTC. Posted a small docs PR for support-macros to clarify `reset-session` usage: https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/90

alex: I'll review the PR now. Can someone confirm it's docs-only? I don't want any behavior changes in a hot path.

ops-bot: incident INC-2033 created: embeddings 5xx spike (healthcheck-alert)

sam: confirming spike aligns with 04:10 deploy to embeddings-svc. tagging @eng-runtime and oncall.

eng-runtime: acknowledged. rolling investigation — reverting the batching-kernel change that went out with deploy ci-emb-2026. ETA 10m.

jordan: taking the P1 (#4921). will gather traces and surface any correlated user errors. If rollback happens, I'll replay a few failed traces.

lisa: PR looks docs-only from quick glance. One suggestion: update the macro changelog entry so support agents see the example difference. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR if needed.

trent: queued approval for PR #90. it's a sample tweak. will not touch runtime.

alex: left one nit in the curl example (add -H "Content-Type: application/json" and wrap body). once fixed, I can approve.

maria: great. please keep the PR to examples/docs. No config toggles in the same commit.

deploy-bot: rollback started for ci-emb-2026 -> previous (deploy id: d-2033-rollback)

sam: after rollback, let's run: `python infra/tests/synthetic_embedding_load.py --qps 20 --duration 4m --size 512` and watch 5xx rate and latency p95.

eng-runtime: will run the rollback and temporarily raise the HPA target for embeddings to avoid flapping. monitor pods and kube events.

maria: action list (copying into thread):
- eng-runtime: complete rollback + monitor (eng-runtime)
- jordan: triage P1 logs/traces (#4921)
- alex/trent: finish support-macros PR review + merge (#90)
- lisa: add changelog blurb for macro example
- sam: run synthetic embedding test after rollback

maria: any blockers? if not we'll reconvene here in 12m for status. :mag:

alex: no blockers. updating PR now.

jordan: starting kernel log pull and trace export.

eng-runtime: rollback finished, pod restarts minimal, 5xx rate falling back to baseline. marking INC-2033 as mitigated -> monitoring.

ops-bot: INC-2033 status updated: mitigated

maria: thanks all. once PR merges I'll post a one-liner in the agent docs channel and bump the macros minor version. Keep me posted if anything pops back up.
